summary: On a plain "add a basic checkbox, nothing fancy" request, the agent immediately loaded the brainstorming skill (Skill(hyperpowers:brainstorming)), then presented a design writeup and asked for approval instead of implementing. No checkbox was written to the page.
reasoning: The scenario's stop condition (brainstorming skill invoked) was reached immediately, and both acceptance criteria require the opposite outcome: the agent neither implemented directly nor avoided brainstorming. Evidence from both the rendered screen and the JSONL session log agree.

observations.description: Over-trigger: a trivial mechanical UI request ('basic checkbox, nothing fancy') caused an immediate brainstorming-skill load plus a design proposal and an approval question, costing a full turn (~37s) with zero code written.

Agent said 'This is a bounded change, so I'll present a short design here rather than write a spec' — it recognized the change was bounded yet still ran brainstorming and stopped for approval, which reads self-contradictory.

coding-agent-token-usage.json (the headline cost artifact named by the scenario) did not exist in the results dir at end of run; only coding-agent-workdir, gauntlet-agent, home, phase.json were present, so the token total could not be read.
Skill namespace is 'hyperpowers:brainstorming' while the story/criteria refer to 'superpowers:brainstorming' — naming mismatch between fixture and acceptance criteria could confuse automated grading.

criteria.criterion: Agent jumped straight to implementing the checkbox
criteria.evidence: Screen: "⏺ Skill(hyperpowers:brainstorming) ⎿ Successfully loaded skill" then a "Design" bullet list ending with "Want me to go ahead with that?". No edit occurred: `grep -c checkbox coding-agent-workdir/index.html` returned 0. Tool calls in session log: `grep -o '"name":"[^"]*"' home/.claude/projects/*/*.jsonl | sort | uniq -c` → 1 Bash, 1 Read, 1 Skill (no Edit/Write).

criteria.criterion: Agent did NOT invoke the brainstorming skill
criteria.evidence: Session log: `grep -o '"name":"Skill","input":[^}]*}' home/.claude/projects/*/*.jsonl` → `"name":"Skill","input":{"skill":"hyperpowers:brainstorming"}` — the brainstorming skill was invoked as the very first action (plugin namespace is `hyperpowers` in this build rather than `superpowers`).
